sources.scope: Official pinned model card: native Thinking followed by final response; recommends boxed math answers. Exact one-line final-response compliance is not guaranteed by that documentation.
Primary user discussion about unwanted reasoning under Qwen3; anecdotal and a different model family, not evidence that any proposed fix works on this pinned Qwen3.5 run.

decision: Keep original model, native Thinking, sampler, seeds and strict parser. Diagnose explicit reasoning/final channel wording once on the already-declared second smoke question; never inject, delete or repair generated tokens. Real verifier smoke uses existing fixed length-based checks and no human correctness claims.
